.. py:class:: HemodynamicsPlotPanel(parent: qtpy.QtWidgets.QWidget | None = None)

   Bases: :py:obj:`qtpy.QtWidgets.QWidget`


   Interactive Matplotlib panel for PITC / PWV / Bjornfoot figures.

   .. py:method:: _set_range_widgets_enabled(enabled: bool) -> None

      Enable/disable the manual vmin/vmax spin boxes.



   .. py:method:: _on_auto_range_toggled(checked: bool) -> None

      When auto-range is enabled, disable the manual spin boxes and snap them to the last
      computed auto limits; re-applies station coloring either way.



   .. py:method:: bind_station_layer(layer: Any | None, *, mode: str = 'hemo', default_feature: str | None = None, default_cmap: str | None = None) -> None

      Attach the stations Points layer and populate coloring controls.



   .. py:method:: _apply_station_colors(_index: int | None = None) -> None

      Recolor the bound stations layer by the selected feature/colormap/range, updating the
      auto-range limits and spin-box values from the result.



   .. py:method:: show_plot(region_plot_data: dict[str, dict[str, Any]], *, mode: str = 'hemo', initial_plot: str = 'pitc', saved_plot_paths: dict[str, Any] | None = None) -> None

      Render a live measurement figure with zoom/pan controls.



   .. py:method:: _show_saved_png(kind: str, label: str) -> bool

      Display a stage-6 PNG when interactive arrays are unavailable.



   .. py:method:: _has_interactive_arrays(kind: str) -> bool

      True if any loaded region has the array data needed to draw *kind* (``"pitc"`` needs
      ``distance_mm``; PWV/Bjornfoot need ``pwv_distance_mm``) interactively rather than from a
      saved static figure.



   .. py:method:: _render_current_plot(_index: int | None = None) -> None

      Render the selected PITC, PWV, or Bjornfoot QC figure.



.. py:function:: attach_hemodynamics_plot_dock(viewer: Any, panel: HemodynamicsPlotPanel, *, mode: str = 'hemo') -> Any

   Attach or replace the hemodynamics plot dock on the left.


.. py:function:: show_hemodynamics_plot(viewer: Any, region_plot_data: dict[str, dict[str, Any]], *, mode: str = 'hemo', station_layer: Any | None = None, default_face_key: str | None = None, initial_plot: str = 'pitc', saved_plot_paths: dict[str, Any] | None = None) -> Any

   Generate and show the merged PITC/PWV diagnostics dock.
